files.README.md:
# Deployment manifest

Manifest files contain one `key=value` pair per line. Blank lines and full-line comments whose first non-whitespace character is `#` are ignored. A `#` inside a value is data and must be preserved. When a key appears more than once, the last value wins.

The CLI and validator use the same parser.
files.docs/format.md:
# Format notes

Full-line comments are documentation and are not manifest entries. Values are not comment-stripped.
files.tests/test_manifest.py:
import unittest

from src.cli import load_and_validate
from src.manifest import parse_manifest


class ManifestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_full_line_comments_are_ignored(self):
        text = """# deployment
service = api
region = us-west
"""
        self.assertEqual(parse_manifest(text), {"service": "api", "region": "us-west"})

    def test_hash_inside_value_is_preserved(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_manifest("service=api#blue")["service"], "api#blue")

    def test_last_duplicate_value_wins(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_manifest("region=one\nregion=two")["region"], "two")

    def test_cli_validation_uses_parser(self):
        text = """service=api
region=us-west
"""
        self.assertEqual(load_and_validate(text)["service"], "api")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
